gaps.text:
CORE GAPS — drawn here, not in core yet (keep updating)

Spectrum
• FFT stream (spectrum + waterfall), with zoom: higher-res FFT of the viewed slice
• Low-latency tuner control over WebSocket (drag-to-pan retunes the centre)

Tuner
• Gain table per tuner, sample-rate presets list
• DC removal, IQ correction

Audio
• One WebSocket audio stream, analog + decoded voice auto-routed
• Auto squelch, configurable AGC, real noise reduction, CW BFO
• Analog audio recording

Data
• Saved frequencies stored in core, shared by all clients
• Signal history per frequency (auto band map)
• Common decode envelope: category, title, fields, freq, raw JSON
• DMR talker alias / error rate in call events (verify)

Activity
• Persistent, searchable event store (full-text incl. transcripts) with paging
• Auto-record all audio (analog transmissions + digital calls), retention, playback by id with seek
• Analog transmission events (start/end, duration) from squelch
• Transcription pipeline (future): per-recording transcript + status
• Operator settings in core, synced to every client incl. mobile: columns, pinned searches, recording prefs, saved frequencies, command history (palette ranking)
• Live event push with replay-from-cursor so a paused or reconnecting client catches up

Recordings
• Keep (star) a recording: exempt from retention, synced to every client
• Manual recordings with name, note and non-destructive trim (in/out)
• IQ capture of the viewed span + IQ playback as a source (spectrum, audio, decoders), SigMF export
• Storage usage and retention endpoint (kept, auto, free)
• Recording deep links and download (Opus / WAV transcode, trimmed)

Map
• Station location in core (lat, lon, altitude), passed to readsb; estimate when unset; gpsd later
• Position history (trails, last-hour replay) with a time cursor
• Coverage: max range per bearing over 24 h (ADS-B, AIS)
• Map tiles: regional PMTiles extract served by core, glyphs and style; OpenFreeMap fallback
• Positions from ACARS / VDL2 (ADS-C, POS) and AIS aids to navigation

Settings
• Settings store in core: saved over the YAML, validated writes, live push to every client; each value says where it comes from (default, YAML, env, UI)
• One settings schema for core and every decoder (Zod + UI hints: label, help, group, essential or More, effect, aliases, widget, unit), served to clients
• Decoder options validated and editable at runtime (PATCH is 501 today); batched apply with restart orchestration
• Station identity (name, location, altitude, region, callsign) owned by core and passed to decoders
• New settings: units, time format, language, FFT size and averaging, auto-squelch margin, global retention and size cap
• Config export / import (YAML), update check, signed-in devices
